scripts.build: npm run check:client && tsc -p frontend/tsconfig.json && vite build --config frontend/vite.config.ts
scripts.generate:rpc: uv run --locked python -m scripts.generate_schemas && uv run --locked python -m scripts.generate_rpc_client
scripts.check:generated: uv run --locked python -m scripts.generate_schemas && uv run --locked python -m scripts.generate_rpc_client --check
